annotations.actionTaken: Cast Solidarity of Heroes during opponent's turn in response to Siona's ETB trigger
annotations.betterLine: Pass without casting Solidarity of Heroes, saving it for a more impactful moment such as before combat on own turn to maximize Fathom Mage card draw or to make better blocks

annotations.description: Haiku Valley has 0 cards in hand, meaning 'Each player discards a card' would be asymmetrically beneficial - opponents lose cards while Haiku Valley loses nothing. This free value mode was not selected alongside the sacrifice mode. Additionally, the sacrifice mode forces Haiku Valley to sacrifice one of their own creatures (likely Mocking Sprite), while GPT5m Rules can just sacrifice a Spirit token (minimal loss).
annotations.actionTaken: Selected only 'Each player sacrifices a creature' as a Rankle mode, missing the free discard mode.
annotations.betterLine: Also select 'Each player discards a card' since having 0 cards in hand makes it pure upside. The 'draw a card' mode could also be considered since Haiku Valley desperately needs cards with an empty hand.

annotations.description: Treasure Cruise has Delve, and GPT5m Rules has 7 cards in their graveyard already, meaning it could be cast for just U (or close to it). At 14 life with a relatively weak board, drawing 3 cards for essentially 1 mana would be extremely valuable. Meanwhile, there are several less impactful cards to discard - lands like Terramorphic Expanse, Evolving Wilds, Seaside Citadel, or Arcane Sanctum (tapped lands) that are far less valuable than a near-free draw-3 spell.
annotations.actionTaken: Discarded Treasure Cruise to Rankle's discard trigger
annotations.betterLine: Discard one of the excess tapped lands (Seaside Citadel, Arcane Sanctum, Terramorphic Expanse, or Evolving Wilds) since they enter tapped and are less impactful than a potential draw-3 for U with Delve.

annotations.description: Kimi25 Dreamer passed priority during combat without activating Spectral Steel's exile ability from the graveyard ({1}{W}, exile to return another Aura from graveyard to hand). With Kenrith's Transformation and other Auras in the graveyard, this would have been free value - especially valuable in a 1v1 situation against the last remaining opponent.

annotations.betterLine: Activate Spectral Steel's exile ability ({1}{W}) to return Kenrith's Transformation (or another useful Aura) from graveyard to hand, as mana was likely available from Sanctum Weaver and Plains

annotations.description: Declined to activate Spectral Steel's graveyard ability ({1}{W}, exile from graveyard to return an Aura from graveyard to hand). Kenrith's Transformation is in the graveyard and would be a valuable recovery - it serves as removal that also draws a card. With 4 untapped mana available and only needing 2 for the activation, this is essentially free value.
